definitions.full: H2695. Chetsro חֶצְרַי חֶצְרוֺ, ( proper name, masculine compare Sabean proper name, masculine חצֿר DHM Epigr. Denkm. 56 ) — one of David's heroes, called the Carmelite , חצרו 2Sam 23:35 Kt ( חֶצְרַי Qr; ᵐ5 Ασαραι ) = חֶצְרוֺ 1Chr 11:37 ᵐ5 Ησεραι , Ασαραι , Εσρει .
